title: Kusanagi Nene — Happy Birthday! 2026〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Festival Grounds

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Here we are!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'd heard this festival was on the smaller side, but there are a good number of stalls set up.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They all look so much fun, I can't decide where to go first. Is there anything you want to do, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, that shooting booth looks like fun.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shooting, huh? There's no line right now, so sounds good to me.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay! Let's have a rooty-shooty contest!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Shooting Booth

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...I missed again. This is harder than it looks.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I haven't hit a single target either!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It never goes where I want it to. Maybe I'm holding the gun at the wrong angle.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Look at that. Kusanagi's on a streak...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: There... That's four.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You're awesome, Nene☆ You're like a real sniper!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're exaggerating. I've just been aiming at the easy targets, that's all.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She's right, you're amazing! We haven't even hit anything.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Is there some trick to it?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hmm... I guess just make sure you line the gun up properly with your sightline. That's how a sniper would do it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ooh, I see! Like this, Master Kusanagi?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Raise the barrel a tiny bit... Right, like that. Now aim just above the prize you want.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hah!
Wow, I hit it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow, that was great☆
Teach me too, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, sure.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're really good at teaching, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Yoyo Fishing Stall

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ooh, look! I got a water balloon yoyo!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I got one too... Huh? I think we got the same pattern, Hanasato.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow, look at that! I wanna match with Nene, too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Why don't we all aim for the same pattern? It can be proof of the bonds of the Nene Birthday Squad♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's a lovely idea. Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Let's see, the same pattern as Kusanagi's...ah, there. It's small, but if I can just hook it...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So close! You almost had it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Your hook slipped at the last second. But your line didn't snap, so you can try again.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You can do it, Mochizuki!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ta-da! My very own matching yoyo☆

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Good job, Emu! Now we all have matching yoyos.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Operation Match With Nene is a success!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know! Why don't we all take a photo together?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That sounds nice. I'll be in the back...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Everyone, surround Nene and get in real close!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay, let's get everyone in the frame... Perfect.
Here goes! Say cheese!
One hour later

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I think that's the last stall we wanted to check out.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Those caramel apples we got sure were tasty.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I could tell you were debating getting a second one, Hanasato.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um, well, this seems like a good time to wrap...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Not so fast!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
We just so happen to have a surprise for you!
Ready, everyone! One, two!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Airi, Minori, Honami & Shiho
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh... Thanks, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Aaand... Here, Nene! This is a present from me and Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's a beige beret. We thought it would really suit you, so we hope you'll wear it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A beret... Thank you very much. I'd never think to buy one for myself, so I'm really happy you got it for me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We actually have a present for you too, Kusanagi. Here—it's a stainless steel water bottle.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's easy to carry, so it'll be handy during practice or when you're running.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, thanks. It's really light, too. I'll start using it tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And last, from me! With all my wishes for us to keep up the good work...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's a matching knitted kitty pouch☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, this is just like the one you have.
The kitty embroidery is so cute...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's keep up the good work, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks so much for today. Going around the stalls with everyone, even getting presents... It was so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you had a good time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You're having a party with Tsukasa and the others after this, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's right. He said to message him when we leave the festival.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're really enjoying the day, huh? Be sure to make lots of fun memories.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks very much. And thank you too, Mochizuki, Hinomori. I had lots of fun hanging out.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I had lots of fun, too. Let's hang out again soon.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. I hope Hoshino and Tenma can make it then, too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ah, Nene! I got a message from Tsukasa! He wants us to come to this address!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay. Looks like we should go, everyone. Thanks again, and see you soon.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: See you! Bye bye!
Rental Room

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wow. Tsukasa rented a pretty big room for this...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?! The lights—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Rui
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Saki
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh?! Hoshino? Tenma?!
What are you doing here? I thought you had plans...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. We finished faster than we thought. And Saki said that if we hurried, we could still make it to your party.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I messaged Tsukasa, and said we'd be joining last-minute!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What a surprise, right?! A birthday is best with as many surprises as possible, after all!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You don't get to take credit for it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm really glad you two could make it. Thank you both.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And with Nene here, I believe it's time we get this party started.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed! If everyone could gather around the cake!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow, it looks so tasty! Look at all the grapefruit on top!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wow, you're right. Did you all prepare this too?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's right! We wanted it to be a cake you would love, so we looked for one made with grapefruit.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We also have birthday candles and tiny sparklers. Also regular fireworks, if you prefer.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Uh, no thanks. But...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You guys got this space, the cake...you even decorated for me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So...you know. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No need to thank us. Today is the birthday of a dear friend and comrade, after all!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's right. This is your day, Nene. Please let us celebrate you in every way we can.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Kusanagi. Emu sent us the photos from the festival. It looks like you all had a great time!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This one of you all with matching yoyos really feels like a snapshot of youth! I hope I can join you all next time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We saw one of you at the shooting stall, too. There's something about your eyes in that one... You look super focused, like a sniper.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't have much experience with shooting booths... But I might be able to take you on in a video game. I hope we'll get a chance to try soon.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Kanade & Ena
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I heard about the festival trip from Ms. Mochizuki. It sounds like you had fun.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You summer babies are lucky, getting to go to festivals for your birthday. There's never much exciting going on around my birthday, so I'm a bit envious.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sounds like it'll be a great memory!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, right, Kusanagi! I got you a present, so I'll visit your class to give it to you! As for what's inside... You'll find out when you get it♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Once again! Happy birthday, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm really glad we got to hang out. If you're free, let's grab a bite together sometime♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ooh, I want to join! I found a cafe that serves grapefruit juice the other day. And it's all fresh-squeezed!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm sure you'd like it, Nene! Let's all go together soon!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Everyone ready? One, two, three!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Saki, Honami & Shiho
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm glad we could celebrate your birthday with you. And I'm very glad you liked your present, too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We were just hanging out today, but I hope we can make it to one of your shows sometime soon.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I wanna go! I really love your singing voice, Nene! It's so beautiful!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I feel the same way. And as an actress, you're so good at putting emotion into it... I feel like I learn so much watching you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Happy birthday again, Kusanagi. Now that your training schedule has settled down, let's practice singing together again sometime.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Neneee! Happy happy birthday!!! I had so much fun hanging out with you today!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It sounds like the show in SEKAI was a big success, as well. I hope it's been a very memorable day for you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It seemed like you enjoyed the cake and decorations, and the surprise magic show too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, Nene was super smiley the whole time! It made me all happy, too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course! Let us continue to spend our days together, overflowing with smiles, just like today!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you all for celebrating my birthday with me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I put on a show with Miku and the others, went to a festival with friends...and even had a birthday party thrown for me. Today has been so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: After getting all these smiles from everyone, I'll have to repay them plenty.
